author: Cleo Abram
description:
If you wanted to drill to the bottom of Antarctica, the first thing you need to realize is this ice is way thicker than you think.

If we were to take a chunk out of this ice and place it on the surface, at its thickest, THIS is what it would look like…

It turns out, there’s a LOT more going on underneath Antarctica than we ever realized. To find out what, subscribe!

#shorts #Antarctica #ice #dig #science
title: The Ice in Antarctica Is Way Thicker Than You Think
